about: The Kody Runtime telemetry taxonomy: every attribute name and every metric, decided once. docs/runtime/observability.md part 2 explains it. apps/runtime-cell/internal/telemetry/taxonomy.json is a byte-identical copy (TestTaxonomyFileMatchesTS).

cardinalities.id: Unbounded identifier: spans and logs only, never a metric label.
cardinalities.tenant: The organization: a metric label only on the metrics that list it (counters, never histograms).
cardinalities.dimension: A closed set of values: span, log and metric label.

kodus.organization.id.meaning: The organization the work belongs to.

kodus.team.id.meaning: The team of the repository that asked.

kodus.repository.id.meaning: The Kodus repository id (not its name).

vcs.change.id.meaning: The pull request number (OTel VCS semantic conventions).

kodus.correlation.id.meaning: The product correlation id a Run was requested with; the Run's trace id is derived from it.

kodus.runtime.environment.id.meaning: The environment a Run, setup or claim boots.

kodus.runtime.run.attempt.meaning: The Run's attempt (Run again increments it).

kodus.runtime.run.phase.meaning: The part of a Run a span or event is about (boot, agent, replay, intent).

kodus.runtime.setup.key.meaning: The idempotency key of an environment setup.

kodus.runtime.setup.state.meaning: An environment setup state (setting_up, active, blocked).

kodus.runtime.setup.outcome.meaning: How a setup ended: active or blocked.

kodus.runtime.recipe.origin.meaning: Where the recipe came from: committed, inferred, authored, or none.

kodus.runtime.preview.id.meaning: One preview of one side of a Run (docs/runtime/preview-urls.md); spans and logs only.

kodus.runtime.preview.access.meaning: How the viewer got into a preview: member (a grant from the app) or link (a share link, a later phase).

kodus.runtime.claim.side.meaning: What a claim boots: base, pr or setup (CLAIM_SIDES).

kodus.runtime.claim.reason.meaning: Why a claim is in its state (CLAIM_REASONS).

kodus.runtime.claim.start.meaning: How the claim's workload came to be: cold, pool or bake.

kodus.runtime.step.id.meaning: One step (probe, exec, browser, reset, sandbox op) on a claim.

kodus.runtime.step.kind.meaning: The step's message type (probe.run, exec, browser.explore, machine.reset, upload, sandbox.op).

kodus.runtime.step.outcome.meaning: How the hub saw the step end.

kodus.runtime.step.reason.meaning: The closed reason of a step that did not end ok.

kodus.runtime.machine.id.meaning: A machine (container or VM) on a cell.

kodus.runtime.secret.id.meaning: An org secret's id. Never its value or its placeholder.

kodus.runtime.cell.owner.meaning: Whose cell it is: kodus or customer.

kodus.runtime.isolation.level.meaning: What the cell's hello says it runs claims under (CELL_ISOLATIONS).

kodus.runtime.boot.phase.meaning: A boot phase the cell timed (prepare, boot, build, up, seed, ready, snapshot).

kodus.runtime.build.export_step.meaning: A part of an image export (export_layers, send_tarball, push_layers, export_cache, unpack_image).

kodus.runtime.egress.phase.meaning: When the proxy denied a request (the egress.blocked phase).

kodus.runtime.blocker.signature.meaning: A blocker's signature class: the catalog prefix, never its repository-derived suffix (blockerSignatureClass).

kodus.runtime.verdict.meaning: A Run's computed verdict: no_regressions, regression, partly_tested, could_not_boot.

kodus.runtime.probe.verdict.meaning: What the gate decided for one probe (VERDICTS).

kodus.runtime.stuck.subject.meaning: What the hang detector found past its bound: run, setup, claim, sandbox, admission, workflow, cell, setup_queue.

kodus.runtime.stuck.state.meaning: The state the stuck item is in.

kodus.runtime.stuck.age_ms.meaning: How long the item has been in its state.

kodus.runtime.stuck.bound_ms.meaning: The longest the code lets the item stay in its state.

kodus.llm.task.meaning: What the model call was for (recipe_author, planner, run_agent, intent, setup_learn, other).

gen_ai.request.model.meaning: The model asked (OTel GenAI semantic conventions).

gen_ai.token.type.meaning: input or output (OTel GenAI semantic conventions).

server.address.meaning: The outbound host of an egress event (OTel). Logs and spans of the egress path only.

kodus.runtime.error.code.meaning: The allowlisted Node error code of a failure (ETIMEDOUT, ECONNRESET, ...).

kodus.runtime.hub.duration_ms.meaning: How long the hub waited for a step.

kodus.runtime.cell.duration_ms.meaning: How long the cell says the step took.

error.type.meaning: The failure category (safeFailure: timeout, cancelled, network, permission_denied, invalid_input, unexpected).

metricLocalLabels.direction: up (to the host) or down (to the machine).
metricLocalLabels.type: The message type a cell nack answered.
metricLocalLabels.outcome: How the operation the metric counts ended; its values are listed with the metric.
metricLocalLabels.reason: Why, from a closed set listed with the metric.
metricLocalLabels.code: A protocol or refusal code from a closed set.
metricLocalLabels.kind: The sub-kind the metric lists (security event kind, evidence kind, step kind on cell metrics).
metricLocalLabels.where: The side a security event was seen on.
metricLocalLabels.state: The producer's own state of what it counts: cell_claims the cell's claim states (acquiring, ready, failed, held, released, not the hub's), runtime.admission.queue_depth the admission request states, cell_host_hardening on, off or unknown (count for check vulnerable).
metricLocalLabels.policy: A microVM cell's host policy: shared or dedicated.
metricLocalLabels.check: What of the host cell_host_hardening reports: smt, ksm, swap or vulnerable.

runtime.run.verdict.meaning: Runs that reached a computed verdict, by trigger.

runtime.run.duration.meaning: Run wall time from start to its final state.

runtime.run.queue_wait.meaning: Time from RuntimeRunRequested to the Run leaving the fair queue.

runtime.probe.verdict.meaning: What the gate decided for each probe.

runtime.setup.outcome.meaning: Environment setups that ended, by outcome and where their recipe came from.

runtime.blocker.meaning: Blockers recorded on a setup or a Run, by kind and signature class.

runtime.llm.budget_used.meaning: Fraction of the Run token budget used after each LLM gateway call (outcome: ok, near_limit, exhausted).

runtime.llm.tokens.meaning: Tokens the product's LLM gateway reported for the worker's own calls (Run agent, intent, setup learning).

runtime.security.event.meaning: Runs halted, or previews stopped (where=preview), because a canary or a credential crossed a boundary (kind: canary, exfiltration).

runtime.evidence.write_failed.meaning: Run evidence the worker could not write (kind: probe, exploration, test).

runtime.claim.hard_expired.meaning: Claims the maintenance loop released past their hard expiry (reason: hard_expired).

runtime.stuck.items.meaning: Items the hang detector saw past their bound at its last pass.

runtime.stuck.detected.meaning: Items the hang detector saw cross their bound (once per item and state).

runtime.claims.open.meaning: Open claims by state at the hang detector's last pass.

runtime.admission.queue_depth.meaning: Admission requests not yet running, by kind (run, setup) and admission state (awaiting_approval, waiting, owned, reserved, dispatched), at the detector's last pass.

runtime.admission.oldest_wait.meaning: Age of the oldest admission request still waiting, by kind.

runtime.maintenance.pass.meaning: Maintenance passes (outcome: ran, skipped (another replica holds the lock), failed).

runtime.claim.ready_wait.meaning: claim.acquire to claim.ready, failed or lost (outcome: ready, failed, lost, released). With consumer sandbox, the sandbox create latency.

runtime.claim.boot_phase.meaning: Each boot phase the cell measured for a claim that became ready.

runtime.build.export_duration.meaning: Image export time of a claim that became ready, by export step (from claim.ready timing.phases).

runtime.claim.start.meaning: Claims that became ready, by how their workload came to be (pool hits: start pool).

runtime.claim.transition.meaning: Claim state changes, by state reached and reason.

runtime.claim.renew.meaning: claim.renew sent for a live claim (outcome: renewed, ceiling, gone, failed).

runtime.claim.capacity_wait.meaning: claim.acquire rounds refused for memory before anything started.

runtime.claim.reconciled.meaning: Claims a cell held that the hub had finished: released on heartbeat.

runtime.machine.gb_minutes.meaning: Machine memory time of claims that ended, as the usage report counts it (claimMbMinutes / 1024).

runtime.machine.vcpu_minutes.meaning: vCPU time of claims that ended whose size is known, as the usage report counts it.

runtime.step.duration.meaning: Step sent to step.result (outcome: ok, timeout, refused, transport_lost, security_violation). With kind sandbox.op, the sandbox operations.

runtime.egress.denied.meaning: Outbound requests the cell proxy denied and reported.

runtime.hub.protocol_violation.meaning: Cell frames refused: outside the schema, or answering a step that is not the cell's.

runtime.hub.background_error.meaning: Failures of background work (pins, revocation, stream, session, frame).

runtime.hub.connection_overload.meaning: Cell connections closed at an outgoing byte or in-flight work ceiling (reason: buffer, frame, requests, steps).

runtime.cell.connected.meaning: Cells connected to this hub replica (sum the replicas).

runtime.cell.sessions.meaning: Cells with a live session on this hub replica, by isolation and driver.

runtime.cell.free_slots.meaning: Claims the connected cells of this replica can still take, from their last heartbeat.

runtime.cell.full.meaning: Connected cells of this replica whose last heartbeat had no free slot.

runtime.cell.heartbeat_age.meaning: Age of the oldest last frame among the connected cells of this replica (a heartbeat is due every 10 s).

runtime.publish.outcome.meaning: Publications the product worker handled. Not exported: the product processes register no meter provider.

runtime.publish.duration.meaning: Publication handling time. Not exported (see runtime.publish.outcome).

runtime.publish.stuck.meaning: Stale final publications in the sweeper's batch. Not exported (see runtime.publish.outcome).

runtime.pool_scheduler.tick.meaning: Pool scheduler ticks (ok, failed, lock_failed, skipped). Not exported (see runtime.publish.outcome).

runtime.preview.session.meaning: Preview sessions opened and refused at the edge; outcome opened or refused, reason from PREVIEW_REFUSALS (no_access, other_org, expired, grant_invalid, grant_replayed, not_found).

runtime.preview.requests.meaning: Browser requests through the edge by outcome only (ok, upstream_error, timeout, no_tunnel, waking, refused, forwarded to the replica holding the tunnel); never a path, a query or a header.

runtime.preview.bytes.meaning: Bytes through the edge, up (to the app) or down (to the browser).

runtime.preview.dropped_cookies.meaning: App Set-Cookie headers with a Domain attribute the edge dropped (until the preview domain is on the PSL).

runtime.preview.tunnels.meaning: Cell tunnels connected to this edge.

runtime.preview.wake_duration.meaning: From a preview's open or wake to ready.

runtime.preview.transitions.meaning: Previews entering each state (starting, ready, sleeping, blocked, stopped, expired).

cell_preview_streams_total.meaning: Tunnel streams the cell served or refused: served, no_route (an id the hub never declared: alarm), upstream_error.

cell_preview_bytes_total.meaning: Bytes through the cell's preview proxy, up (to the app) or down (to the edge).

cell_preview_tunnels.meaning: Preview tunnels this cell holds open to an edge (0 or 1).

cell_claims.meaning: Claims the cell holds, by its own claim state (acquiring, ready, failed, held, released).

cell_free_slots.meaning: Claims the cell can still take.

cell_memory_committed_mb.meaning: Memory the cell's claims are counted for.

cell_memory_allocatable_mb.meaning: Memory the cell may commit to claims.

cell_deadman_state.meaning: 0 healthy, 1 lost (no new work), 2 abandoned (every machine destroyed).

cell_pool_ready.meaning: Warm pool machines ready, every environment.

cell_pool_machines_total.meaning: Warm pool machines (outcome: created, failed, adopted, discarded).

cell_claims_reaped_total.meaning: Claims the cell tore down without a claim.release.

cell_steps_total.meaning: Steps run, by kind and outcome.

cell_sandbox_ops_total.meaning: Sandbox operations the guest agent ran (op: the sandbox.op kind; outcome: ok, refused, failed).

cell_sandbox_op_milliseconds_total.meaning: Time in sandbox operations; divide by cell_sandbox_ops_total for the mean.

cell_egress_seals_total.meaning: Sandbox egress seals (egress.policy sealed): the policy pushed to the enforcers allows nothing (outcome: ok, failed).

cell_tool_layer_builds_total.meaning: Tool layer builds the cell ran in a clean builder sandbox (outcome: built, failed).

cell_exfiltration_alerts_total.meaning: Injector alerts the agent acted on: a claim's credential or bait left for a host it was not for.

cell_alert_source_available.meaning: Whether the configured alert sources have verified continuity; zero until negotiated or while unavailable.

cell_alert_source_failures_total.meaning: Alert source failures, by closed reason.

cell_egress_hosts_denied_total.meaning: Egress policy hosts the cell refused to open (platform deny list).

cell_injector_swaps_total.meaning: Requests whose placeholders the injector swapped for a secret (outcome: swapped, no_secret, refused).

cell_injector_alerts_total.meaning: Placeholders or credentials the injector saw going to a host they were not for.

cell_injector_inspected_requests_total.meaning: Requests to a host of the inspected tier, by outcome (allowed, or the refusal: inspect_method, inspect_path, inspect_body, inspect_uri, inspect_git_push, placeholder).

cell_hub_deliveries_total.meaning: Claim frames delivered to the hub (outcome: acked, nacked, refused, gave_up, dropped).

cell_hub_delivery_retries_total.meaning: Resends of claim frames the hub did not ack.

cell_hub_frames_refused_total.meaning: Frames from the hub the decoder refused or that named another cell.

cell_driver_calls_total.meaning: Driver calls, by operation and outcome.

cell_driver_not_owned_total.meaning: Driver calls refused because the machine is another cell's.

cell_cert_seconds_left.meaning: Seconds until the client certificate expires.

cell_reaper_terminated_total.meaning: Machines the independent reaper destroyed past kodus:hard-expires.

cell_reaper_pass_failures_total.meaning: Reaper passes that ended with an error.

cell_reaper_orphans_total.meaning: VMM processes, cgroups, jails, taps and machine namespaces the reaper removed that no machine record named.

cell_host_hardening.meaning: A microVM cell's host: 1 on the state of smt, ksm and swap; the count of unmitigated CPU vulnerabilities (check vulnerable).

cell_browser_explorations_total.meaning: Browser exploration completions (outcome: observed, blocked, timeout, unavailable, failed).

cell_step_conflicts_total.meaning: Steps refused because their stepId was seen with another command.

cell_hub_nacks_sent_total.meaning: Nacks the cell sent to the hub.

cell_hub_nacks_received_total.meaning: Nacks the hub sent to the cell.

cell_hub_unmatched_acks_total.meaning: Acks or nacks for a frame already answered or no longer waited for.

cell_driver_call_milliseconds_total.meaning: Time in driver calls; divide by cell_driver_calls_total for the mean.

cell_mirror_cache_evictions_total.meaning: Blobs evicted from the OCI mirror cache.

cell_mirror_cache_bytes.meaning: Bytes held by the OCI mirror cache.

kodus_egress_denied_total.meaning: Connections the egress proxy denied, by its closed reason. Served on the proxy's mTLS control port (GET /metrics).

kodus_egress_live_connections.meaning: Connections the egress proxy holds open.

kodus_egress_bytes_total.meaning: Bytes the egress proxy relayed (direction: up, down).

kodus_egress_upload_budget_exceeded_tota.meaning: Claims whose upload passed the per-claim budget (observe-only: counted and logged once, never cut).

kodus_egress_inspect_bypassed_total.meaning: TLS connections to an inspected host that went through without inspection (a source that does not trust the cell CA); 0 when every build trusts it.

cell_mirror_cache_requests_total.meaning: OCI mirror requests by what the cache did.

cell_openbao_up.meaning: 1 when the injector's last OpenBao health read answered unsealed, 0 when sealed or unreachable.
